description.value:
From Spiderweb Stand · Price: it only works through existing spiderwebs.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: You sense through any web within 60 ft. 1 action: your stand spins a web over a 10-ft square within 30 ft (difficult terrain for 1 minute); each creature you choose in the square is cut by the tightening strands, @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[slashing]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}), and stuck fast on a failure: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} until the start of your next turn; on a critical failure @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round.
  • 5: Surge: webs snap shut over creatures you choose in a @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-ft burst} within 30 ft: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[slashing]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); on a failure @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 round, on a critical failure for 1 minute.
  • 9: Move a creature's limbs through webs: it drops an item.
  • 13: Block speech through a web: the creature can't speak. The webs gag and wrap it: the 5th-level bind lasts 1 minute on a failure, and on a critical failure it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained} for 1 round.
  • 17: A creature that critically fails against your web bind is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained} for 1 round.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
